entries.name: Hebi Regeneration
entries.text: At the beginning of each of your turns, roll 1d8. On a roll of 5-8, regain a number of hit points equal to twice your level.

entries.name: Primary Target
entries.text: As a bonus action, mark one creature you can see within 60 feet. A creature marked by this feature cannot gain the benefits of stealth against you.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.text: The Hebi Genin may make two attacks with its currently equipped weapon.

entries.name: Katana
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage.

entries.name: Senbon
entries.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

name: Hebi Chunin

entries.name: Hebi Regeneration
entries.text: At the beginning of each of your turns, roll 1d8. On a roll of 5-8, regain a number of hit points equal to twice your level.

entries.name: Sneak Attack
entries.text: Once per turn, you deal an extra 1d8 damage per two levels when you hit a target with an attack and have advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of your ally, as long as you don't have disadvantage.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.text: The Hebi Chunin may make two attacks with its currently equipped weapon.

entries.name: Katana
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage.

entries.name: Senbon
entries.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

notes: The Bukijutsu C-Rank line prints "(Cost: 5)"; corrected to 9.
